$source: Desktop synthesis rulings over the Orca lane canon. Canon files stay verbatim from lane-systems; this overlay resolves their OPEN markers.
$designer_approval: 2026-08-28 — APPROVED by the designer: S1 (VP 0-20, 16/+3 · 10/+8 · 18/−8), S2 (band-valued Wilds), S3 (Corrupt Gate Way 3), S4 (first-gift-only Light cap), S11 (Standard 15 default mode + endgame scoring VP>Light>GuardianVP), S12 (companions CUT for v1 — first post-launch module), S13 (fight tie = win, draw >= F), S14 (art: painterly storybook). S5-S10 pending explicit review; treat as proposed.

S11_default_mode.endgame: at limit: most VP, ties by Light then Guardian VP

S1_vp_scale.rule: VP lives on a 0-20 track sharing Light's order of magnitude (the hypocrisy penalty forces this).
S1_vp_scale.note: Guardian 3/9/27/54 CE-mirror ladder from the guardians proposal is REJECTED per the synthesis brief (conflict #1); rescaled to 1/2/4 (+3).

S2_wild_and_fights.wild_rule: Spirit/Wild fate cards are NOT auto-win. A Wild resolves to a value set by your current Duality band: max_dark 1, dark 2, neutral 3, light 4, max_light 5. Zero new card text; kindness literally changes your luck.
S2_wild_and_fights.common_f_bump: Common creatures' printed F raised toward the tier guide: F3 becomes F4, F4 stays F4 (guide C 3-4 -> effective 4). Kills Common-tier cherry-pick fighting profit.
S2_wild_and_fights.fight_trigger: fight_creature -1 Light on WIN is canon (already in duality.json); a lost fight is the Bite, no shift.

S3_way3_exists.rule: Way 3 is real but never enters the 4D/Ascended board. Dark players end at the CORRUPT GATE on the T2/Ascended border: at max_dark it opens and hosts their Master Guardian confrontation. Cost parity: the Dark chain's total cost equals the Light chain's actual cost (fixes the 2.8x-cheaper inversion found in the guardians review).
S3_way3_exists.digital_v1: Sanctum ring is light-gated as before; a max_dark player instead gets the Corrupt Gate action at any Guardian site.

S4_gift_cap.rule: Care-phase giving grants at most +1 Light per Care phase, total, regardless of gifts/trades made. Action-phase give_back_light (+2) is unaffected. Physically executable, closes the pass-the-card loop.

S5_viability_test.rule: Hand-checkable viability: a player has a viable path if for ANY Way: (rounds_left * 2) >= VP still needed AND (rounds_left * 3) >= Light distance still needed. Reach constants TUNE; on the 4D board double the Light reach.

S8_companion_track.rule: OUT for v1 (cut Temper/favor/companion). Creature card chassis keeps Demand/Gift/Bite/F/Quirk. Companions return as a future module.

S10_ring_split_baseline.rule: Adopt the recovered split (4 gathers outer / 3 inner, 2 explores outer / 1 inner, 2 creatures outer) as the documented baseline.

best_of_both.from_orca_lanes: entire canon: Care+Action turn, 6 main actions, Duality -10..+10 bands+shifts, hypocrisy penalty, Energy 0-5, Island Rage 0-10, Fate deck, CE tier ladder, deck compositions, gather rules, modes, setup, 6 elements w/ domains, creature chassis, 4 characters, pytest invariants I1-I15
best_of_both.from_godot_v01: the shippable Godot app, hex board with T1/T2/Sanctum rings, pass-and-play flow, autosave, creature band UX (gift/reward/challenge/take/attack mapped onto canon bands), original-spec fairness rules (3 common quests easy/med/hard, majority redraw, non-owner decides), dark-win house rule, ship pipeline
best_of_both.characters_merge: lane identities + Godot numeric loadouts: Cartographer(move 4, pack 4, heart water), Botanist(move 3, pack 5, heart wood), Blacksmith(move 2, pack 6, heart stone), Outcast(move 3, pack 4+2 hand, heart ether)
